data.title: Payment demand for painting invoice (Werklohnforderung)
data.summary: The law firm Rechtsanwälte Musterhoff & Kollegen, acting for Malerbetrieb Beispielfarbe GmbH, demands that Anton Musterschmidt pay €1,915.72 (unpaid invoice plus default interest and legal fees) for painting work done in September 2025, by 25 February 2026, or the matter may go to court.
data.explanation: A law firm is collecting an unpaid bill for painting work on your house on behalf of the painting company. The amount (€1,915.72) includes the original invoice, interest for late payment, and the firm's own fees. You're asked to transfer this to the IBAN shown by 25 February 2026. If you don't pay in time, the firm says it will advise its client to sue you without warning you again, which could add court costs. If you dispute the amount or already paid, contact the firm in writing right away with proof. Given the size of the claim and the threat of a lawsuit, consider getting advice from a lawyer or consumer advice center before the deadline.
